summary: Frontend-only testing for the restructured AMYA Cashew Brittle product page. All functional requirements verified at mobile 375/390/430 and desktop 1440.

verifications.pack_cards: 500 g ₹500 / 10 pieces  and  1 kg ₹900 / 20 pieces present; no 250g/₹300
verifications.default_selected_pack: 500 g (aria-pressed=true); terracotta bg rgb(185,80,64) when selected
verifications.quantity_row: QUANTITY  −  n  +  with data-testids qty-minus/qty-value/qty-plus works
verifications.whatsapp_default_url: wa.me/919675334567?text=... Cashew Brittle / Pack: 500 g (10 pieces) / Quantity: 1 pack / Total: ₹500
verifications.whatsapp_1kg_x3_url: wa.me/919675334567?text=... Cashew Brittle / Pack: 1 kg (20 pieces) / Quantity: 3 packs / Total: ₹2,700
verifications.order_button_above_prelaunch: pd-whatsapp-enquiry at top=876 appears BEFORE pd-prelaunch at top=1010 (qty-value=823)
verifications.accordions_below_order_section: Description, Ingredients, Storage, Delivery, Returns & cancellation render in collapsible accordions below the order+prelaunch section
verifications.desktop_two_column_1440: grid lg:grid-cols-2 renders cleanly; terracotta header/footer and ivory logo intact
verifications.floating_wa_vs_order_cta: No spatial overlap observed (floating at ~x326,y776 48x48; CTA fills row at x20,width350). Auto-hide is NOT implemented, but there is no actual visual collision in current layout.

action_items: Optional: implement auto-hide/opacity-0 on data-testid=floating-whatsapp when the pd-whatsapp-enquiry CTA enters the viewport (IntersectionObserver). Currently no overlap but spec explicitly asks for auto-hide.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.jsx is clean (243 LOC) and uses env-driven whatsapp number via useConfig with sane fallback.
orderMsg builder correctly interpolates product name, pack label, note (pieces), qty and total with ₹ and en-IN formatting.
All interactive elements have data-testid as required.
test_credentials: N/A (no auth required for this flow)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cashew Brittle product page redesign fully verified. WhatsApp order deep-links contain the correct product, pack label, pieces, quantity and total for both default (500g x1 = ₹500) and 1kg x3 = ₹2,700. Order CTA sits immediately below the quantity row and above the Pre-launch notice. Only outstanding (minor) item is implementing an auto-hide on the floating WhatsApp FAB when the primary CTA is in the viewport — no actual overlap in current layout.
